{"step":1,"file":"jbig2_generic.c","function":"jbig2_decode_generic_mmr","line":1208,"var":"segment->data_length - offset","code":"code = jbig2_decode_generic_mmr(ctx, segment, &params, segment_data + offset, segment->data_length - offset, image);","note":"The generic region passes the remaining encoded bytes for MMR decoding as the buffer size."},
{"step":2,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_halftone_mmr","line":1147,"var":"*consumed_bytes","code":"*consumed_bytes += mmr.data_index + (mmr.bit_index >> 3) + (mmr.bit_index > 0 ? 1 : 0);","note":"The MMR decoder reports how many bytes it believes it consumed back to its caller."},
{"step":3,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_consume","line":86,"var":"mmr->data[mmr->data_index + 4]","code":"if (mmr->data_index + 4 < mmr->size) mmr->word |= (mmr->data[mmr->data_index + 4] << mmr->bit_index);","note":"When prebuffer refills reach the end of the segment, bytes past the end are not read but the input cursor still advances."},
{"step":4,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_consume","line":88,"var":"mmr->data_index","code":"mmr->data_index++;","note":"The internal consumed-byte counter increases even for bytes that were skipped from the prebuffer refill."},
{"step":5,"file":"jbig2_halftone.c","function":"jbig2_decode_halftone_mmr","line":340,"var":"size - consumed_bytes","code":"code = jbig2_decode_halftone_mmr(ctx, &rparams, data + consumed_bytes, size - consumed_bytes, GSPLANES[j], &consumed_bytes);","note":"The caller subtracts the reported count from the remaining size to decode the next plane."},
{"step":6,"file":"jbig2_halftone.c","function":"jbig2_decode_halftone_mmr","line":340,"var":"size - consumed_bytes","code":"code = jbig2_decode_halftone_mmr(ctx, &rparams, data + consumed_bytes, size - consumed_bytes, GSPLANES[j], &consumed_bytes);","note":"Because the reported count can exceed the actual bytes read, this subtraction underflows and the next decode starts from the wrong location."},
{"step":7,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_line","line":874,"var":"mmr->word","code":"white_run = jbig2_decode_get_run(ctx, mmr, jbig2_mmr_white_decode, 8);","note":"Subsequent decoding uses the stale/shifted word buffer and continues reading from outside the intended encoded input buffer."}
]'''
